verdict.rationale: The evidence points to usage-based pricing, not seat-based. Cloudflare states it charges only for compute, not wall time (docs-15), that idle agents cost nothing (docs-32), and that Workers AI avoids paying for unused infrastructure (docs-24). That suggests costs scale with workload rather than headcount, but no evidence says outright whether seats or minimum seat counts exist. Missing for 10: an explicit statement on per-seat or team-member billing, documentation of minimum seat counts or team-plan tiers, a published pricing page with plan details, and independent corroboration that adding team members does not raise cost.
